rules.baselines: train mean and median net return; flat gross price after costs; train and calibration profit prevalence; always buy common account; holding cash returns0 before interest/inflation
rules.bootstrap: paired5-observed-date blocks,1000reps seed20261024,95percent; not corrected for repeated experiments, not probability of profit
rules.calibration: 6 separate L2 logistic sigmoid fits on next chronological year raw decision scores; no test data, no random CV; regression80% absolute residual interval from same calibration year
rules.comparison: three chronological test years2024/25/26; old anchorRidge saved control matched by ticker/instant; old price MAE and new net-return MAE are different targets, not comparable
rules.features: original causal17:45 base18; optional5 leave-self-out features from same UTC instant
rules.label: 100*(next10open*(1-.0005)*(1-.0005)/(entry18open*(1+.0005)*(1+.0005))-1)
rules.limits: current survivor stocks/UID/lots; missing holidays remain unknown; no dividend cash/tax/auctionqueue; no historical orderbook/news/traderidentity, no worst overnight drawdown or verified fills
rules.paper: same100000RUB cash account; max25percent/stock, whole lots; fee/slip .05percent each per side; stress doubles both; selected unknown makes entire subsequent P&L undefined
rules.peers: all eligible peer X before any outcome filtering; prior complete reference may be older than1day; no backfill; zero peers=>five zeros; coverage=count/6; only current seven-stock basket
rules.policies: regression net>.10percent; joint net>.10percent AND calibratedP(net>0)>=.55; thresholds fixed before fits; stress repeats identical decisions
rules.reuse: all years already inspected, exploratory reuse, NOT untouched holdout; no winning-model promotion
rules.unknowns: entry OR exit missing => unknown net/profit; preserve every eligible forecast
